Definition: from G4452 and G4218; at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time:--at any time, + never (…to any man), + yet, never man.
BiblicalUsage: Popote means at any time, and with a negative it means never. John says no man has seen God at any time, and John says it again in his letter: no man hath seen God at any time, but if we love one another, God dwelleth in us.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no one has seen God, yet his love made visible in us is how the unseen God is known.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
